title: Choose the visual world for AiFoundIt search
question: The roll assigned Contact Sheet & China Marker. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Contact Sheet & China Marker
options.lineage: Photographers' darkroom contact sheets, marked up with a grease pencil
options.thesis: Each assistant reply is a contact sheet of your own files, with the finds circled in china marker.
options.viewport: Material 3 top bar and chat composer. The reply is a strip of three frames on a black film rebate; the matching frames get a hand-drawn yellow loop and orange edge print (name · date · source).
options.risk: Documents and audio need authored frame faces so they don't look like second-class photos.

raised.raise: A strict set of marks: circle means match, arrow means proposed move, X means proposed exclusion, crop corners mean selected. No other state decoration.
Indexing is a pale band across the sheet whose length is exactly the share of files indexed so far: a measured quantity, not a spinner.
Frames snap to fixed cells and reflow by whole frames only: 3 per strip on a phone, 5 on a tablet.
Every frame has the same edge-print fields: name, date, where it came from, and a one-line note on why it matched (shown on demand).
A live monospace counter in the edge print, e.g. 12,408 FILES · ON DEVICE.

options.label: Material You, Expressive
options.lineage: Material 3 Expressive with dynamic color from the user's wallpaper
options.thesis: The assistant takes on your phone's own colors, so it feels like part of the device.
options.viewport: Large headline greeting, tonal suggestion chips, and found files as large rounded tonal cards inside the reply.
options.risk: Familiar: it sits right next to Gemini and Files by Google, and the brand would mostly disappear into the system.

options.label: Claim & Proof Monochrome
options.thesis: Every sentence the assistant writes is immediately backed by the file that proves it.
options.viewport: Each assistant sentence is followed by its file proof. Confirm is the only filled control on screen.
options.case: Equal on clarity (sentence plus proof is exactly the chat pattern), but generic for the audience; nothing about it says 'your phone'.
options.risk: Very close to the category standard; easy to mistake for any AI chat app.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Conversations are tabbed sections; replies sit on clear acetate leaves over a colored board.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail for history; the current chat is laid out as acetate leaves.
options.case: Loses on both axes: everyday users don't recognize manuals, and the layered acetate slows down scanning.
options.kept: Its strict, rule-bound set of state marks.
options.risk: Heavy, and reads as a novelty on a phone.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: The conversation as a vertical score read upward, with block length showing duration.
options.viewport: A center staff with user and assistant columns mirrored on either side.
options.case: Loses on both: the encoding is foreign, and chat already has a direction of reading.
options.kept: Geometry that shows an exact quantity (the indexing band).

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible construction grid that results snap into.
options.viewport: Grid lines behind the chat; results occupy whole cells.
options.case: Loses on both: an insider design reference that doesn't make finding files any clearer.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Each file category becomes a mascot, with a name plate and a short note.
options.viewport: A roster of category mascots above the chat.
options.case: Loses on both: its playfulness contradicts the calm, trustworthy voice.
options.kept: The same fixed set of facts on every item.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: One live control reshapes the whole screen.
options.viewport: A slider drives how relevant the shown results must be.
options.case: Loses on both: there's no real job for an axis slider in finding a file.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A standard AI chat app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The chat layout people already expect, with file results as attachment rows.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Gemini or ChatGPT by design.
